details: Bitcoin experienced a notable surge above $66,500 after reports emerged of a preliminary peace agreement between the United States and Iran. This development sparked a broader "risk-on" rally across financial markets, leading to the liquidation of over $150 million in Bitcoin short positions and driving up shares of crypto-related companies like Coinbase and Robinhood.
title: Bitcoin Surges on US-Iran Peace Deal News

details: Uniswap (UNI) saw a significant price jump, climbing 23% in one day, following a bullish forecast from Standard Chartered analysts. The bank projected that UNI could reach $100 by 2030, highlighting its crucial role as infrastructure for tokenized real-world assets.
title: Standard Chartered Predicts $100 Uniswap by 2030

details: As of June 17, the cryptocurrency market exhibited a cautious sentiment. Bitcoin was trading between $64,833 and $66,818, experiencing a 2.36% decline by 09:30 AM (UTC). Ethereum also registered a decrease of 0.89% to $1,775.04. Despite these individual asset dips, the global cryptocurrency market capitalization saw a modest increase of 1.81% over the past 24 hours, indicating a mixed but overall cautious trading environment for major digital assets.
title: Crypto Market Shows Cautious Trading Amidst Mixed Performance
